Firefly works with no mobile signal. It needs a few permissions to talk to nearby phones and place you on the venue map.
Your phone broadcasts a tiny Bluetooth signal with your position and relays your friends\' signals. No pairing, no connections.
GPS puts your dot on the map. Android also requires location permission for Bluetooth scanning.
A persistent notification keeps Firefly running while your screen is off.

Your position is only shared with the group you join, is not encrypted in this test build, and is never stored after you leave the group. There is no server: Firefly does not even have internet permission.
Firefly cannot work without these. Please allow them in Settings.
